name: Laguna Beach Run Club
description: Grassroots run club founded by Laguna locals in 2024. Sunday runs from Catch Surf, Tuesday evening runs at Cameo Shores, and monthly trail runs at Alta Laguna Park. Grew from zero to 100 runners in months — all paces, all ages welcome.

events.title: Sunday Morning Run
events.description: Weekly 3-3.5 mile group run starting at Catch Surf. All paces welcome — we regroup so nobody gets left behind. Coffee after.
events.address: 1043 N Coast Hwy, Laguna Beach, CA 92651

events.title: Tuesday Evening Run
events.description: Midweek shakeout run at Cameo Shores at 6:30pm. Trail vibes, ocean views, and a solid crew.
events.address: Cameo Shores Rd, Corona del Mar, CA 92625

events.title: Last Sunday Trail Run
events.description: Monthly 4-mile trail run at Alta Laguna Park. 8am start. Moderate difficulty with stunning views. Last Sunday of every month.
events.address: 3299 Alta Laguna Blvd, Laguna Beach, CA 92651

name: RunOC
description: Running, Drinking, Laughing in SoCal. Six years of Wednesday social runs in Irvine — 2-4 miles, runner's choice. Completely free, no membership. Just show up, run, do 20 pushups together, then grab dinner.

events.title: Wednesday Social Run
events.description: Weekly social run at 6pm. 2-4 miles along the Jeffrey Open Space Trail — runner's choice of distance. Group pushups and optional dinner after.
events.address: 100 Trabuco Rd, Irvine, CA 92620

name: Huntington Run Club
description: Surf City's social run club. Wednesday night and Saturday morning runs along the Huntington Beach coast. No membership, no fees — just show up and run with the crew.

events.title: Wednesday Night Coastal Run
events.description: 6:30pm group run along the HB coast. 3-5 miles, all paces. The best way to break up your work week.
events.address: 315 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648

events.title: Saturday Morning Run
events.description: Weekend group run at 9am. Coastal route with ocean views the entire way. Coffee meetup after.
events.address: 315 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648

name: Fast Friends Run Club

events.title: Thursday Night Run
events.description: Weekly 5K run starting at Everywhere Beer Co. at 7pm. All paces welcome. Post-run beers and socializing at the brewery.
events.address: 1501 W Orangewood Ave, Orange, CA 92868
